result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 5-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns. Use character-specific effects and props; do not add a recurring golden-fist emblem or generic fist-shaped power effect.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

Squabble House Manager — Home Advantage.
IDENTITY: exact massively muscular adult dark-skinned manager, close hair under white hairnet, short goatee, small gold earring, white collared shirt, black printed apron, black gloves, bright yellow trousers, striped kitchen towel and black work boots. Preserve the source uniform lettering as fixed costume detail. He balances the original oval breakfast plate of waffle, eggs, bacon and hash browns in his left hand. His right hand is free.
0–0.7s: full-body low angle. He levels a warning finger with his free right hand while holding the breakfast platter perfectly horizontal. The small butter pat lifts a few inches off the waffle from a tiny wrist toss. A red diner chair flies toward him from deep cyan, followed by two metal stools.
0.7–2.5s: camera sweeps around his massive shoulder as he ducks beneath the chair, rolls his right elbow under its seat and detonates upward with a full-body uppercut using that same forearm. The chair shoots thirty feet upward and backward, smashing through both incoming stools in one tremendous escalating furniture chain collision. Large bounded ivory/orange contact stars, a short dominant impact hold, stools tumbling away in readable arcs. His left arm keeps the entire breakfast level throughout, no food spills and no human opponent.
2.5–3.5s: snap back toward his stern face and untouched plate as the exact title HOME ADVANTAGE slams below his chest with a huge diner-tray clang. His hairnet and apron snap from the recoil; preserve the hat, build and face. Every unoccupied area remains cyan; no restaurant, floor or tables.
3.5–5s: whole-character composition. The SAME butter pat falls precisely back onto the center of the waffle. He catches the final descending bent chair leg between two right-hand fingers, tosses it aside without a glance, and extends the immaculate breakfast toward camera with an expression that says service continues. SFX: small plate swish, three incoming furniture whistles, huge uppercut WHAM and cascading metallic crashes, title slam, soft butter plop and tiny chair-leg rattle. No voice, music or added captions.
